title: SOOTS & Music Maker
description: Since 2006, SOOTS has raised money for the Music Maker Relief Foundation, which supports aging roots musicians.

blocks.body: SOOTS is modeled on the work of Tim and Denise Duffy and their Music Maker Relief Foundation, which supports aging roots musicians with concerts and tours, help with recording, and direct financial aid. Since 2006, Raleigh Charter students have raised money for Music Maker through the Fat Tuesday Feastival, the May Day Cake Bake, and annual benefit concerts from 2007 to 2014 featuring Music Maker artists like John Dee Holeman, George Higgs and Boo Hanks. Along the way we have stamped and stuffed envelopes at the Duffys' home offices, sponsored three Medical Relief Grants for our dear friend George Higgs, and visited Music Maker's new studio in Fountain, NC.
